prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: NPC portrait speech-mouth atlas for Daggerfall Unity
Input image: Image 1 is exact NPC072 mouth-reference-grid.png. Use it as the only visual reference.
Primary request: Create one 3x3 atlas of the same woman's complete original 64x29 lower-face crop. Cell order A B C / D E F / G H X. Canvas ratio 64:29. Keep each full crop at same scale and registration, including nose, jaw, chin, neck, hair, background and original lip center. No labels, gutters, borders, extra panels or zooms.
Emotion: Make this happy atlas visibly warmer than neutral through a soft smile, gently lifted mouth corners and subtle natural cheek creases. Keep smile restrained. No giant grin, downturned corners, or same full smile in every phoneme.
Identity and palette: Preserve source identity and muted warm tan/brown skin, soft dark rust-brown lips, source lip scale and softened pixel clusters. No lipstick red, broad orange patches, bright shiny teeth, tooth gaps or warm skin-colored teeth. Teeth, where pose requires them, are modest muted ivory/gray, distinct from skin, with gentle cavity contrast.
Rhubarb mouth pose definitions:
A: Pressed closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M.
B: Slightly open with teeth nearly together and narrow horizontal opening for most consonants and EE.
C: Medium opening with relaxed unrounded lips for EH/AE.
D: Wide vertical opening for AA, larger than C.
E: Slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: Puckered rounded lips with small forward opening for UW/OW/W; not a tooth bite.
G: Upper teeth touch lower lip for F/V; not a wide open vowel.
H: Tongue raised behind upper teeth for long L; opening between C and D. Tongue may be small at native scale.
X: Relaxed closed idle lips.
Constraints: Keep every cell a complete identical-size lower-half crop. Change lips and required mouth interior only; keep nose, jaw, chin, neck, hair and exterior source-registered. Preserve distinct pose families and happy expression without overstatement. No text or watermark.
